# Whimbrel Research

Whimbrel Research does prospect research for medical device development
firms. We read the public record daily, NIH SBIR/STTR awards, FDA 510(k)
clearances and PMA approvals, clinical trial registrations, SEC filings,
and granted patents, and match funded medtech companies to a development
firm's capabilities and focus. Every fact we publish links to the public
source it came from; anything that cannot be verified is not published.

The corpus currently tracks 2308 US medtech companies, monitored daily.

## Data files on this site

- /signals-latest.json: national medtech buying signals (NIH awards, FDA
  clearances and approvals) from the last 7 days. Updated daily.
- /hot.json: companies with a buying-window event in the last 14
  days. Updated daily.
- /methodology.md: how this data is collected and verified, and what the
  free feed deliberately excludes.

This free feed is a rolling window. The full corpus, its history, and
company-to-firm matching are the paid service.

## Attribution and contact

Free to cite with attribution to Whimbrel Research (whimbrelresearch.com). Every fact links to its public source. Matched, verified research for medtech development firms: nate@whimbrelresearch.com
